tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to .Chart.AppVersion when empty.

host.description: Required. The public hostname Helve is served from, e.g. helve.example.com. The chart refuses to render without this set.

replicaCount.description: Safe above 1: session/proxy state lives in Postgres and quota enforcement uses a Postgres advisory lock, not in-process state.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Must comfortably exceed the app's own ~5s post-SIGTERM wait plus real request completion time. Does not help already-open long-lived connections (proxied app sessions, the Pods tab's live-update WebSocket).

baseDomain.description: Base domain per-deployment proxy origins are served under ("<name>.<baseDomain>"). Defaults to "proxy.<host>" when empty. Needs a wildcard DNS record for "*.<baseDomain>".

separateOrigins.description: Serve each proxied deployment from its own origin (recommended, default true). Setting this false is only accepted alongside allowSameOriginProxy=true.

allowSameOriginProxy.description: Explicit acknowledgment required to set proxy.separateOrigins=false, since that lets a proxied app's JavaScript call Helve's own API as whoever is browsing it.

mode.description: certManager renders a Certificate; existingSecret uses tls.secretName as-is; none leaves TLS to something in front of this chart.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret holding a Postgres connection string. The supported path — either this or database.deploy.enabled must be set.

existingSecretKey.description: Key within existingSecret holding the connection URI.

enabled.description: Evaluation only. Deploys a single-replica, no-backups CloudNativePG Postgres alongside Helve. Requires the CloudNativePG operator already installed on the cluster. Do not use for anything you'd be upset to lose.

className.description: StorageClass name; empty uses the cluster default.

mode.description: off (default): no home-directory feature. hostPath: mount <hostPath.basePath>/<username> from every node's own filesystem. pvc: one PersistentVolumeClaim per user from pvc.storageClassName.

basePath.description: Required when mode=hostPath. Every node must already have the same shared filesystem mounted at this path at the OS level.

storageClassName.description: Required when mode=pvc. Must support ReadWriteMany if a user can run more than one home-drive environment at once.

size.description: Size of each per-user home PVC.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret (key: password) to use instead of adminBootstrap.password.

password.description: Convenience only: creates the initial admin account on first boot against an empty database. Prefer adminBootstrap.existingSecret if this password shouldn't sit in your values file or Helm release history.

create.description: Creates a namespace-scoped Role + RoleBinding. Never a ClusterRole.
